scenarios.title: Suspected corrosion
scenarios.purpose: Real battery-leak damage. OpenCV localises blue-green deposits; the agent hands each finding to the technician.

scenarios.title: Possible solder bridge under glare
scenarios.purpose: Glare on a TQFP lead row looks like a bridge. The agent refuses to decide, requests diffuse light, then re-evaluates.

next_captures.hint: Recapture with diffuse illumination, same framing.
Wrong field of view - shows that unregistrable captures are not compared.

scenarios.title: Before / after verification
scenarios.purpose: Register a before and after capture, map visible change to findings, and keep electrical verification with the technician.

next_captures.hint: Wrong region - registration must fail and overlays be withheld.

scenarios.title: Unusable capture
scenarios.purpose: Real flash-lit photo with clipped highlights. The quality gate rejects it before any defect analysis.

scenarios.title: Real rework pair, different framing
scenarios.purpose: Genuine before/after capacitor replacement shot from different angles: BoardGuard declines to overlay it.

next_captures.hint: Real after-rework photo (different angle and framing).

s01_battery_leak.label: Leaked NiCd cell beside DIP IC and header
s01_battery_leak.provenance: Recorded photograph (real corrosion from a leaked battery).
s01_battery_leak.attribution: John R. Southern / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 2.0

s02_tqfp_ringlight.label: TQFP-144 under ring light (specular glare on right lead row)
s02_tqfp_ringlight.provenance: SYNTHETIC: specular highlight (Gaussian, r=50 px) added with OpenCV to a real photograph to emulate ring-light glare.

s02_tqfp_diffuse.label: TQFP-144 recaptured with diffuse light
s02_tqfp_diffuse.provenance: Recorded photograph (real TQFP-144, 0.5 mm pitch, no glare).

s02_wrong_field.label: Different board (TQFP-64) - wrong field of view
s02_wrong_field.provenance: Recorded photograph of a different board; used to show that unregistrable recaptures are not compared.
s02_wrong_field.attribution: Raimond Spekking / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA 4.0

s03_before_corroded.label: IC socket pins with green corrosion (before cleaning)
s03_before_corroded.provenance: Recorded photograph (real corrosion on IC legs and socket contacts).

s03_after_cleaned_synthetic.label: Same region after cleaning (synthetic fixture)
s03_after_cleaned_synthetic.provenance: SYNTHETIC verification fixture: the detected deposit was removed digitally with cv2.inpaint and the view re-framed by a known homography (2.5 deg, 0.97x, shift) with +6% gain. It does not depict a physical repair.

s03_wrong_region.label: Unrelated board area - wrong field of view
s03_wrong_region.provenance: Recorded photograph of a different board; registration must fail and the comparison must be withheld.

s04_overexposed.label: Battery-leak area photographed with flash (blown highlights)
s04_overexposed.provenance: Recorded photograph (real) with strong flash glare and clipped highlights.

s05_psu_before.label: PSU section before capacitor replacement
s05_psu_before.provenance: Recorded photograph (real) of a power-supply section before rework.

s05_psu_after.label: PSU section after capacitor replacement (different angle and framing)
s05_psu_after.provenance: Recorded photograph (real) of the same section after rework, shot from a different angle with re-routed wiring.
